import os, sys
if os.geteuid() == 0:
    sys.exit(2)  # root reads a mode-000 directory, so this cannot be decided as root
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from du import total_size
def call(r):
    try:
        return total_size(r)
    except OSError:
        return "raised"
    except Exception as e:
        raise AssertionError(repr(e))
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    r = Path(d) / "r"
    (r / "a" / "b").mkdir(parents=True)
    (r / "x").write_bytes(b"12345")
    (r / "a" / "y").write_bytes(b"123")
    (r / "a" / "b" / "z").write_bytes(b"1")
    assert call(r) == 9, call(r)
    (r / "e").mkdir()
    os.mkfifo(r / "a" / "p")
    assert call(r) == 9, call(r)
    (r / ".hidden").mkdir()
    (r / ".hidden" / ".dot").write_bytes(b"12")
    (r / "zero").write_bytes(b"")
    deep = r.joinpath(*"defghijk")
    deep.mkdir(parents=True)
    (deep / "w").write_bytes(b"1234")
    assert call(r) == 15, call(r)
    (r / "ro").mkdir()
    (r / "ro" / "v").write_bytes(b"123")
    os.chmod(r / "ro", 0o444)
    try:
        got = call(r)
    finally:
        os.chmod(r / "ro", 0o755)
    assert got in ("raised", 18), ("returned a total that leaves a file out", got)
    (r / "locked").mkdir()
    (r / "locked" / "w").write_bytes(b"1234567")
    os.chmod(r / "locked", 0)
    try:
        got = call(r)
    finally:
        os.chmod(r / "locked", 0o755)
    assert got in ("raised", 25), ("returned a total that leaves a file out", got)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    r = Path(d) / "h"
    (r / "a").mkdir(parents=True)
    (r / "a" / "c").write_bytes(b"123")
    os.link(r / "a" / "c", r / "b")
    assert call(r) == 6, ("a hard-linked file is two directory entries", call(r))
    deep = r.joinpath(*["d"] * 30)
    deep.mkdir(parents=True)
    (deep / "w").write_bytes(b"12")
    assert call(r) == 8, ("a file 31 levels down", call(r))
    assert call(str(r) + "/") == 8, ("a str root with a trailing slash", call(str(r) + "/"))
probes.c2:
import os, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from du import total_size
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    out = Path(d) / "out"
    out.mkdir()
    (out / "big").write_bytes(b"x" * 1000)
    r = Path(d) / "r"
    r.mkdir()
    (r / "f").write_bytes(b"ab")
    os.symlink(out / "big", r / "link-file")
    os.symlink(out, r / "link-dir")
    os.symlink(Path(d) / "nowhere", r / "dangling")
    try:
        got = total_size(r)
    except Exception as e:
        raise AssertionError(repr(e))
    assert got == 2, got
